text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor s-t-a-t-e-d a d-e-s-i-r-e for m-e-d-i-c-a-l f-a-k-e-s in t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t r-e-c-o-r-d and l-e-f-t a w-r-i-t-t-e-n p-l-a-n b-e-h-i-n-d w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g any l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-c-y c-h-e-c-k.
2) the actor p-l-a-n-n-e-d to r-e-l-a-b-e-l the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d p-r-o-d-u-c-t with f-a-l-s-e b-r-a-n-d d-e-t-a-i-l-s and l-e-f-t a l-a-b-e-l t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) the actor i-n-t-e-n-d-e-d to f-a-l-s-i-f-y s-e-r-i-a-l i-z-a-t-i-o-n c-o-d-e-s to m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g and l-e-f-t a s-e-r-i-a-l n-u-m-b-e-r l-i-s-t b-e-h-i-n-d w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-r-a-c-e-a-b-i-l-i-t-y a-u-d-i-t.
4) the actor p-l-a-n-n-e-d to a-l-t-e-r c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e l-o-g-s to show p-r-o-p-e-r s-t-o-r-a-g-e c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n-s and l-e-f-t a t-e-m-p e-r-a-t-u-r-e r-e-c-o-r-d f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-n-s-o-r c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the actor o-u-t-l-i-n-e-d a d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n r-o-u-t-e t-h-r-o-u-g-h p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y n-e-t-w-o-r-k-s before d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n m-a-p a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
